name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: An official, app-store-style listing of add-ons for Claude Code, so anyone can browse and install extra tools and integrations with one command.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev-tools studio who wants free, trusted distribution for a Claude Code plugin instead of building their own marketing and discovery.
business_use_cases: A plugin developer submits their tool here to get discovered by a large existing user base without any marketing spend.
A consultancy builds internal plugins and lists them here to build a public portfolio and credibility with enterprise clients evaluating them.
An enterprise security or platform team reviews the external_plugins directory before deciding which third-party plugins employees are allowed to install.

money_ideas.idea: Build a plugin that solves a specific workflow, list it here for free distribution, then sell a paid hosted or managed version of the same workflow.

steal_this: Pick a workflow you repeat daily inside Claude Code, wrap it as a plugin this weekend, and submit it to the directory purely for the free exposure.
